mapper.sql: e.id, e.emp_no, e.name, e.gender, e.phone, e.email, e.education, e.dept_id, e.position_id, e.user_id, e.shift_id, e.emp_type, e.status, e.entry_date, e.regular_date, e.leave_date, e.create_time, e.update_time, d.name AS dept_name, p.name AS position_name, u.username, s.name AS shift_name
FROM hr_employee e LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = e.dept_id LEFT JOIN hr_position p ON p.id = e.position_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = e.user_id LEFT JOIN hr_shift s ON s.id = e.shift_id
mapper.select:
SELECT e.*, d.name AS dept_name, p.name AS position_name, u.username, s.name AS shift_name
WHERE e.id = #{id}

SELECT e.id, e.emp_no, e.name, e.dept_id, e.user_id, e.shift_id, e.status, e.entry_date, e.leave_date, d.name AS dept_name FROM hr_employee e LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = e.dept_id WHERE e.entry_date <= #{to} AND (e.leave_date IS NULL OR e.leave_date >= #{from})
AND e.dept_id IN #{d}
AND (e.emp_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR e.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY e.emp_no

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'LEFT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "active", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PROBATION' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "probation", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN entry_date >= #{monthStart} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "joined", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'LEFT' AND leave_date >= #{monthStart} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "lefted" FROM hr_employee

SELECT e.dept_id AS "deptId", d.name AS "name", COUNT(*) AS "value" FROM hr_employee e LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = e.dept_id WHERE e.status <> 'LEFT' GROUP BY e.dept_id, d.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
SELECT COALESCE(education, '') AS "name", COUNT(*) AS "value" FROM hr_employee WHERE status <> 'LEFT' GROUP BY education ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

SELECT
COALESCE(p.name, '-') COALESCE(dd.dict_label, e.emp_type, '-') COALESCE(dd.dict_label, e.education, '-') COALESCE(d.name, '-') AS group_name, SUM(CASE WHEN e.status <> 'LEFT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active, SUM(CASE WHEN e.status = 'PROBATION' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS probation, SUM(CASE WHEN e.entry_date BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS joined, SUM(CASE WHEN e.status = 'LEFT' AND e.leave_date BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lefted FROM hr_employee e
LEFT JOIN hr_position p ON p.id = e.position_id LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data dd ON dd.dict_type = 'hr_emp_type' AND dd.dict_value = e.emp_type AND dd.tenant_id = #{dictTenant} LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data dd ON dd.dict_type = 'hr_education' AND dd.dict_value = e.education AND dd.tenant_id = #{dictTenant} LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = e.dept_id
WHERE (e.status <> 'LEFT' OR e.leave_date >= #{begin} OR e.entry_date >= #{begin}) GROUP BY
e.position_id, p.name e.emp_type, dd.dict_label e.education, dd.dict_label e.dept_id, d.name
ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN e.status <> 'LEFT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC
